text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is awful~!
Another one of my fave UmaTokkers vanished!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, if you're ever having a rough time, tell me right away!
I'm totally here to listen!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And then we'll sing karaoke till dawn! So don't quit!
...Even though we've never met before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With nowhere to direct her frustration,
Daitaku Helios was left trapped in a funk.
